organization.favorite_hint: The app opens on the favorite organization, otherwise on My space.

install.title: Install the app
install.subtitle: On your home screen, works offline too
install.ios_step_share: Tap Share at the bottom of the screen
install.ios_step_confirm: Tap Add. The icon lands right on your home screen.
install.ios_outro: Once installed, the app opens full screen and keeps your pending recordings even offline.
install.android_intro: Chrome did not offer the automatic install. It still takes three taps:
install.android_step_menu: Open the Chrome ⋮ menu, top right
install.android_step_install: Tap "Install app" or "Add to Home screen"
install.android_step_confirm: Confirm. The icon lands on the home screen or in the app list.
install.android_outro: If the menu shows "Open LinTO Studio", the app is already installed: look for it in the app list.

update.available: A new version is ready. Reload the page to use it.

record.denied: Microphone refused. Allow it in the browser settings.
record.local_only: Local recording only. Nothing is sent while recording.
record.keep_screen_on: Keep the screen on: the phone cuts the microphone when the screen locks.
record.name: Name
record.offline_send: Offline: the recording will be sent by itself when the network is back.
record.interrupted: The recording was interrupted (call, screen lock or microphone lost). What was captured is kept.
record.microphone_permission: Allow the microphone to list the inputs.
record.quiet_warning: The microphone barely picked up anything. Check the selected input before sending: an empty transcription fails.

queue.status_offline: Will be sent when back online
queue.error_offline: Offline, will retry when the network is back.
queue.error_network: The server did not answer, automatic retry.
queue.error_missing: Recording not found on this phone.
queue.play_failed: Audio not found on this phone.

live.end_text: The session becomes a conversation in your media.
